rows.text: **Skimming and scanning.** Skimming reads quickly for the main idea; scanning searches the passage for a specific fact such as a date, name or number.  ·  **Main idea and support.** The main idea is the point of the whole passage; supporting details explain, prove or illustrate it and usually answer factual questions.

rows.label: MCQ drill
rows.text: A common examiner point on "Reading Comprehension" is that a statement is only valid when its condition of applicability is met. Is that TRUE or FALSE? → True

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Inference.** An inferred answer is not stated outright — it combines stated details with the reader's reasoning to reveal what the writer implies.  ·  **Vocabulary in context.** Unknown words are decoded from surrounding clues: synonyms, contrast words (but, however), examples and word roots.  ·  **Answering strategy.** Read the questions first, locate the relevant paragraph, answer in your own words unless quoting is required, and check that every part of the question is answered.
